implB.name: chess-plugin
implB.outcome: draw (noCheck treats all no-moves as stalemate)

note: Plugin uses noCheck:true to handle the grid-crossing constraint on attacks. Side effect: when opponent has no legal grid-crossing moves AND is in grid-check, MCE reports checkmate but the plugin reports draw/stalemate. Needs a custom checkWin or grid-aware check detection to distinguish the two cases.
